rationale: Nothing is broken; the source asks to compose a new capability out of eight named-but-unverified building blocks (scraping DSL, browser drivers, Chrome DevTools MCP, wiki, Obsidian, Telegram/WhatsApp, AgentsFlow-as-tool, Calendar). The research must therefore verify which of those exist today, in which distribution, and with what contract — not diagnose a defect.

queries.intent: Locate the WebscrapingToolkit and its JSON/DSL definition layer — the reuse anchor for the whole proposal
Find the selenium and playwright browser drivers and their shared driver abstraction
Enumerate the scraping/browser source tree to see module boundaries and where a BrowserAutomationToolkit would land
Read the DSL step/action model that a browser-automation directive language would extend
Determine how external MCP servers (e.g. chrome-devtools) are consumed as agent tools

params.pattern: MCP client external server tools consume

queries.intent: Verify whether a WikiToolkit exposing wiki_query/wiki_remember as agent tools exists in-process (vs only the MCP stdio server)

params.pattern: wiki toolkit agent tools wiki_query wiki_remember

queries.intent: Verify whether an ObsidianToolkit / Obsidian vault mirror exists, and how FEAT-452 audio-notes-obsidian relates
Locate the Telegram integration and confirm whether a WhatsApp channel exists in ai-parrot-integrations
Confirm the mechanism by which an Agent invokes an AgentsFlow as a tool

params.pattern: AgentsFlow as tool agent invoke flow

queries.intent: Find any Google Calendar / Google Workspace toolkit for the tax-deadline reminder requirement
Find Excel/spreadsheet loaders for the bank-statement ingestion path
Determine how credentials/secrets are supplied to tools (browser login to Hooba needs them)

params.pattern: credentials secrets navconfig environment tool configuration

queries.intent: Find scheduling/cron machinery for recurring tax-deadline reminders
Read the AbstractToolkit contract that BrowserAutomationToolkit must implement
Check the wiki namespaces / federation feature (FEAT-450) as the substrate for a per-business wiki plane
Recent activity on the tools distribution to see whether scraping/browser code is actively moving
Recent activity on integrations to gauge Telegram/WhatsApp maturity
Read the FEAT-452 audio-notes-obsidian spec — it may already define the Obsidian write path this proposal needs

expected_findings: A concrete WebscrapingToolkit DSL with a serializable step/action model that a browser directive language can extend or fork
A driver abstraction shared by selenium and playwright implementations
Confirmation of whether the Chrome DevTools MCP is registered in .mcp.json and consumable by an in-process agent
Whether WikiToolkit and ObsidianToolkit exist as agent toolkits or must be built
Whether WhatsApp exists at all in ai-parrot-integrations, or only Telegram
The concrete API for wrapping an AgentsFlow as a tool
Whether Google Calendar and scheduling support exist or are net-new
Where credentials for an authenticated browser session would come from

meta.schema_note: Query types wiki_query/wiki_page/wiki_related are mandated by the /sdd-proposal command (Phase 2, wiki-first) but are NOT yet in research_plan.schema.json v1.0 type enum. Schema is stale relative to FEAT-403/FEAT-450; recorded here rather than downgrading the queries.
